task_specification.objective: Repair the ordinary five-wave route and terminal lifecycle, restore authored arena spatial integrity, and make enemy vitality plus upgrade choices visibly readable and truthful in the survivor HUD.

diagnosis.root_cause: Ordinary progression is not advancing beyond Wave 1 during fresh movement replay, so the Bellkeeper and terminal route are unreachable. Separately, vitality bars have authoritative-looking bindings but are hidden in the shipped presentation, and the choice surface needs to be verified as a visual decision interface rather than a prose stack.

stop_conditions: Exactly the three bounded product families below are implemented and self-checked.
Deferred dense-performance qualification and Godot MCP rebind work are not expanded into candidate changes.
Runtime recapture, formal gap verdicts, and issue closure remain with Host and Tester.

strategy.rationale: Use direct authoritative state-machine, terminal-shell, and presentation-binding repairs, with authored-map spatial anchoring, instead of another transform-tuning pass. Preserve the bound cemetery package, camera, and weapon resources while making each failed surface directly retestable.

code: Run Godot parser/static checks for every modified script, scene, and resource.

Execute focused candidate checks for contiguous wave transitions, single Bellkeeper request, terminal commit/reset, vitality visibility/update/retirement, and truthful choice projections/focus predicates.
Verify preserved cemetery, camera, and weapon resource bindings remain loadable and no release export exposes tester-only controls.
runtime: Host/Tester recapture fresh ordinary movement from spawn through Waves 1-5, Bellkeeper, Result, and Retry without fixtures.
Capture movement replay across the central building/landmark and boundary/perimeter, including collision and occlusion/disappearance checks.
Capture damaged ordinary enemies, death/pooling cleanup, upgrade page focus with keyboard/mouse/gamepad, Result summary, and post-Retry clean state for formal gap verdicts.
visual: At the configured 1280px gameplay framing, inspect compact vitality bars, HUD health/experience/wave readability, and absence of opaque-panel clutter.
Inspect upgrade cards for silhouettes/icons, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new deltas, restrained copy, and distinct focus states.
Inspect spawn, critical route, landmark, and perimeter views for external depth, coherent cemetery composition, stable collision alignment, and no camera occlusion drift.

done_when: Fresh ordinary input advances Wave 1 through Waves 2, 3, 4, and 5 in contiguous authored order without diagnostic jumps or tester fixtures.
Wave 5 requests the Bellkeeper exactly once and keeps supporting crowd spawning within declared caps.
The arena provides a larger traversable scale or expanded walkable route while retaining coherent external world or external depth beyond the playable loop.
Movement replay reaches the central building or landmark and the boundary or perimeter from spawn using authored paths; collision agrees with visible geometry.
Every prominent landmark and perimeter segment retains stable visibility during ordinary movement, with no disappearance or camera occlusion drift.
The player cannot pass through central-building or perimeter collision, and no invisible barrier blocks the ordinary movement route.
tasks.instructions: Repair the authoritative wave director and authored-world spatial owners as one bounded pass. Diagnose why fresh ordinary movement remains in Wave 1, then restore contiguous five-wave timing, composition escalation, and the final-wave Bellkeeper request without relying on validation jumps. Rebase spawn, objective, collision, navigation, and camera framing onto the intact authored cemetery map; use a larger traversable scale or expanded walkable route and only additive outer datum/anchors when required. The implementation and checks must explicitly cover external world/external depth, central building/landmark, collision, disappearance/occlusion, boundary/perimeter, and ordinary movement/movement replay. Keep preserved native map/camera assets and avoid proxy-floor replacement or decorative asset expansion.
tasks.title: Advance five waves and restore arena spatial integrity

done_when: Bellkeeper defeat commits one victory or failure outcome through the authoritative run controller and reaches the Result presentation with truthful time, level, defeated enemies, damage dealt, damage taken, selected upgrades, and outcome.
Result and Retry preserve input focus and pause ownership, then start a clean new run with reset wave, health, experience, upgrade transaction, actors, pickups, audio, and UI state.
No spawning, attacks, pickups, or stale terminal callbacks continue after Result or during the new run.
A failed run can still prove failure, Result, and Retry without being counted as a successful build route.
tasks.instructions: Repair the terminal lifecycle and result shell around the Bellkeeper handoff. Keep boss defeat, failure, result commit, and retry as single-shot authoritative transitions; ensure the result summary is populated from the completed run ledger and that Retry tears down actors, pickups, audio, pause/input context, and UI before beginning a fresh run. Maintain distinct ordinary-success and failure semantics so only a complete ordinary route can qualify a viable build. Provide deterministic state receipts for host retesting without auto-advancing or auto-committing release gameplay.
tasks.title: Make Bellkeeper Result and Retry lifecycle truthful

done_when: Damaged ordinary enemies show compact camera-facing world-space vitality indicators with readable contrast at gameplay framing.
Each bar is bound to authoritative current/max health, updates its fill on damage, appears on damage/focus/proximity, and retires on death, pooling, despawn, Result, and Retry.
Vitality bars remain above the correct actor and do not become a dense field of opaque panels or obscure the player HUD.
Every upgrade/weapon choice leads with a recognizable silhouette or authored icon and compact stat icons.
Each card shows truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas; unchanged, exhaustive, NEW, and LOCKED placeholder rows are omitted from CURRENT values.
Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, unavailable, and selected states are visibly distinct without changing card dimensions or hiding tradeoffs.
The authoritative selected id, rank, and applied modifier remain visible in runtime state after choosing a card.
tasks.instructions: Repair the real HUD and upgrade-draft presentation bindings. Trace the hidden-bar cause through scene ownership, visibility/alpha, billboard orientation, actor-generation binding, and lifecycle cleanup; make ordinary enemy vitality visible only when useful while preserving the dedicated boss-health treatment. Rework choice cards into an authored visual hierarchy with silhouette/icon, compact stat icons, restrained copy, and truthful current-to-new deltas limited to three decision-relevant stats. Preserve existing weapon and upgrade resources, bind cards to actual projections and applied results, and implement complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states rather than debug or prose-only controls.
tasks.title: Expose vitality feedback and authored upgrade-choice hierarchy
